name: io.github.ege-usta/lomberk
title: Lomberk
description: Postgres gateway for AI agents: blocks destructive SQL, holds risky writes, undoes applied ones.

environmentVariables.name: LOMBERK_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the lomberk.yaml that `lomberk setup` wrote. The connection strings and keys are read from the .env beside it.

environmentVariables.name: LOMBERK_AGENT_DSN
environmentVariables.description: Connection string for the low-privilege role the agent's SQL runs as. Only needed when the .env beside lomberk.yaml doesn't set it.

environmentVariables.name: LOMBERK_ADMIN_DSN
environmentVariables.description: Connection string for the control role that owns the lomberk schema (checkpoints, undo, ledger). Only needed when the .env beside lomberk.yaml doesn't set it.
